title: The United Quark Network Database — Determinism Spec
description: Determinism contract for the The United Quark Network Database: every record in every member database derives reproducibly from base data — atomic numbers and CIAAW 2021 atomic weights for matter; quark quantum numbers for quarks. Same inputs, same records, every build. No invented values anywhere in the chain.
how_it_works: The spec is enforced at build: formula parsing, mass derivation, isotopic variants, and hadron composition are all computed, then re-derived independently in the embedded JavaScript demos, which fail the build on any mismatch.
